title: Rho hero
description: A centred near-black hero: a hairline mono badge with a blinking mint square, an 80px regular-weight headline on two lines, a short lead, an email field with a mint button beside an outline and a light button, small fine print, then a wide product shot that grows from 90% to full width as you scroll, over a faint glow.
notes: best dark (tone="dark" by default); the product-shot placeholder is an inverse (white on dark) panel
media: the product screenshot (1.57 wide); backdrop: anything behind the hero (the original has a WebGL starfield)
CSS only: the badge square blinks five times on load; the shot scales with a scroll-driven animation
name: rho-hero
